about: A grid of units (squares, dots or little people) that colour in group by group: how many out of a total, one in four, odds and rates made countable.

total.about: how many units in all (up to 400)

count.about: how many units each group takes, split by commas

names.about: what each group is, split by |

restName.about: what the uncoloured units are, listed after the groups

when.about: moments each group colours in; else when its name is said, or one after another
